text: Entry 489 changes the Local address-book label and its Fluent ID together; the XHTML consumer points to about-addressbook-toolbar-add-address-book, while CardDAV and LDAP keep separate IDs. In D214666, a reviewer rejects the proposed migration that copies a unified-toolbar translation into this address-book resource. The author removes that script, and both reviewers accept the resulting local ID change. This is the outcome for this specific migration proposal; it does not ban Fluent migrations or establish translated values on other branches. The review also agrees to skip 128, so central acceptance does not authorize an ESR label uplift. Proposed review check for a similar rename: verify the new resource ID in every consumer and preserve the target branch's localization decision. No migration execution, performance check, rendered label or accessibility test ran.
title: Keep a renamed address-book Fluent message in its own resource
